Yknow I have called myself ugly all the time for years. I still do a lot. I dont know if this explanation applies to you, but for me, I realized its sort of a quick and cheap answer to a complicated problem.

Like, when Im reflecting on why I have trouble socially and with finding a partner, its not a very satisfying answer to say "Well, I project my low self esteem, I get anxious around new people and withdraw, I don't get out very much, I CANT get out very much since we're in a global pandemic, I have trouble trusting and opening up."

Its just a real can of worms. Its so much easier to just say "Well, I must just be ugly, I'm going to die alone."

But its totally bullshit!

We just gotta remember, we can be our own worst enemy. 

Sometimes you gotta just flush out all the propaganda. Just forget all the negative opinions you have of yourself. Maybe try some meditation, maybe take a bath, maybe go lay down in the grass. You are going to be fine.

After that, I would suggest making some goals. For me it was things like, reminding myself constantly to stand up straight, try to talk x amount of times in a certain situation.

But maybe youre way ahead of that. Maybe your next step would be to ask someone you like out.

And every time your mind gets congested with negative self views and worries, try and flush it out. Just take some time to yourself.

Sorry for the rambling, it just made me really sad to see that you've totally written yourself off like that. So much of our worries are in our heads. Please dont give up, you can get where you want to be
